scope: Recorded software checks, not universal compiler correctness or a graph-exclusion certificate.
bvls_command: python3 -B -c 'from scripts.production_positive_controls import check_planted; print(check_planted("bvls243", "z2-f1")); print(check_planted("bvls243", "z3-fpf"))'

default_serialization_regression.reference: Unmodified main-root production modules; not the historical deposited SAT inputs

limitations: Auxiliary extensions are checked in disjoint batches with primary and conjunction values fixed.
Both full BvLS runs use a fixed independently constructed graph, not an unconstrained graph search.
The full Z7 and Z3-fixed3 production encodings are not validated by these graph controls.
Old standalone SRG and planted matching encoders remain explicitly experimental.
